name: Alrund
description: Alrund is the blue-aligned god of Wisdom and the Cosmos on Kaldheim, who sometimes travels in mortal disguise as the old advisor Asi with his raven Hakka.

description_citations.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

summary.text: Alrund is the blue-aligned god of Wisdom and the Cosmos on Kaldheim, who sometimes travels in mortal disguise as the old advisor Asi with his raven Hakka.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Alrund set out to become the wisest being, taking secrets from each Cosmos monster as it submitted to him over centuries.

citations.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cosmos", section "Cosmos Monsters". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He found an orphaned baby in an eagle's nest, adopted him as Halvar, and left him as the dwarf king's ward for twenty years.

citations.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He also had three children with Cosima, and he gifted the Feltmark to Hurrik and his descendants after Hurrik saved his life.

citations.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: As Asi he joined Inga Rune-Eyes and Kaya to hunt a monster, then revealed himself and raised a barrier, and he promised Kaya Cosima's longship and warned of a coming Doomskar.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.
"Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.
"Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

bio.text: In Aldergard the party fought Vorinclex, whom Alrund's barrier drove from Bretagard.

citations.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He told Kaya, Tyvar and the clan leaders that only Halvar could wield the Sword of the Realms and that it must be given to him to end the Doomskar.

citations.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

status.text: The material does not show his fate, and the latest mention is a card flavor text saying he captures the secrets of the Cosmos.

citations.work: Reality Fracture Commander: card flavor text
citations.text: Reality Fracture Commander: card flavor text (Reality Fracture Commander, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Omenseekers arrive by ship at Sevalgr, a village plagued by disappearances.
timeline.quote: There could be no mistaking them. Omenseekers.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Inga orders a war party into the Aldergard forest, noting Kaya came up with the idea.
timeline.quote: I want a war party ready to set off within the hour.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In the Aldergard, Asi and an Omenseeker discuss whether the culprit is the Cosmos Monster Sarulf.
timeline.quote: He is one of the Cosmos Monsters.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Asi's raven Hakka returns and leads the party to a cave.
timeline.quote: my friend may have found us a lead

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Asi glows with divine light, revealed as Alrund, and shields the party with a barrier; the monster flees into the metal vein.
timeline.quote: it seemed to sink into the metal, as it if were a thick and viscous liquid

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund explains gods travel in mortal guise and Kaya berates him for letting the monster escape.
timeline.quote: It suits the gods, from time to time, to travel in mortal guise

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund promises Kaya the longship of Cosima to pursue the creature across realms.
timeline.quote: the longship of Cosima will aid you in this quest

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund opens a doorway into the void and warns of a coming Doomskar.
timeline.quote: I fear a Doomskar approaches—one unlike any in living memory.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund steps from the shadows and says only Halvar, God of Battle, can wield the sword.
timeline.quote: The god for whom the sword was meant. Halvar, God of Battle.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
timeline.quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya presents the Sword of the Realms; Alrund reveals it was made for Halvar, and the group sets out to find him.
timeline.quote: it had been made for Halvar , God of Battle, who alone could master it.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurrik, founder of the Beskir, once saves the god Alrund's life.
timeline.quote: Their founder, Hurrik, once saved the god Alrund 's life.

citation.text: "Bretagard", section "The Beskir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Inga's party engage Vorinclex in Aldergard and Alrund reveals himself.
timeline.quote: the party engaged Vorinclex

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and the Omenseekers fight Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and the praetor flees.
timeline.quote: The god Alrund revealed himself, too disgusted at Vorinclex, and the praetor fled

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex invades Kaldheim and is confronted by Kaya, Alrund and the Omenseekers; he wounds Esika and leaves with a tyrite sample.
timeline.quote: he fought and wounded the god Esika before leaving Kaldheim with a sample of tyrite

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Vorinclex on Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund undertakes a quest to become the wisest being, taking secrets from each Cosmos monster as it submits over centuries.
timeline.quote: By making every Cosmos monster submit to him one by one over centuries, Alrund was able to take their secrets from them.

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund finds an orphaned baby in an eagle's nest on Axgard, adopts him as Halvar, and leaves him as ward of the dwarf king for twenty years.
timeline.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurrik saves Alrund's life and Alrund gifts the Feltmark to Hurrik and his descendants.
timeline.quote: Alrund gifted the Feltmark to Hurrik and his descendants

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Asi, Alrund joins Inga Rune-Eyes and Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster that proves to be Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: This turned out to be none other than Vorinclex

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Aldergard the party fights Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and creates a barrier, and the praetor leaves Bretagard.
timeline.quote: the praetor left Bretagard, with Kaya soon following

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund instructs Kaya, Tyvar and the clan leaders that the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar to end the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cosima and Alrund have three children and live in the Gods' Hall for twenty years before she leaves for the sea.
timeline.quote: She and Alrund had three children

citation.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund makes every Cosmos monster submit to him over centuries and takes their secrets.
timeline.quote: the god Alrund was able to take their secrets from them

citation.text: "Cosmos", section "Cosmos Monsters". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Esika and Tergrid come into being when Alrund uses runic magic to commune with the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Esika and her sister Tergrid came into being when Alrund used runic magic to commune with the World Tree .

citation.text: "Esika", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund adopts an orphaned baby found in an eagle's nest and names him Halvar, leaving him as the dwarf king's ward for twenty years.
timeline.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar

citation.text: "Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Aldergard forest the party fights Vorinclex; Asi reveals himself as Alrund, who raises a barrier, and Vorinclex leaves Bretagard.
timeline.quote: Alrund used his magic to create a mystical barrier between Vorinclex and Inga's people and the praetor left Bretagard

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund advises taking the Sword to Halvar; Kaya, Tyvar and Arni fly on a giant raven but Varragoth attacks, and they fall near the Dread Marn.
timeline.quote: Mounted on a giant raven Kaya, Tyvar and Arni flew toward Halvar

citation.text: "Sword of the Realms", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
